summary: Stereo resonant filter effect with Neo Poly's filters: the ladder (low-pass 24 or 12 dB/oct) and the state-variable filter (low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, notch, peak; 12 or 24 dB/oct), cutoff in Hz, resonance as Q up to self-oscillation that stays bounded, drive (soft saturation, oversampled), an envelope follower (attack, release, sensitivity, ± octaves) and an LFO (free or synced to the tempo, seven shapes, stereo phase, locked to the song or restarted by the input) both moving the cutoff, dry/wet mix and output. Zero latency; at Mix 0 % it passes the input bit for bit. Use it for filter sweeps, auto-wah, dub high-pass and low-pass moves, resonant tones and tempo-synced movement.
use_for: Resonant ladder or state-variable filter with drive, envelope follower and tempo-synced LFO.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: Ladder: Neo Poly's transistor ladder, low-pass 24 or 12 dB/oct (resonance thins the lows, as a ladder does); SVF: the state-variable filter's low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, notch or peak (unity on both sides, a peak of 2Q at the cutoff)
parameters.how: Chooses the filter: a 24 or 12 dB per octave ladder low-pass, or a state-variable low-pass, band-pass, high-pass, notch or peak.
parameters.sound: The ladder sounds warm and thick, low-pass types remove highs, band-pass and high-pass thin the sound, notch and peak carve or boost one spot.

parameters.name: Slope
parameters.description: SVF low-pass, band-pass, high-pass and notch: one section (12 dB/oct) or two alike in series (24 dB/oct, the resonance's peak doubled in dB). The ladder and the peak ignore it
parameters.how: Chooses a 12 or 24 dB per octave slope for the state-variable low-pass, band-pass, high-pass and notch (the ladder and peak ignore it).
parameters.sound: 24 dB per octave cuts more sharply, so the filtered range disappears faster; 12 dB is gentler and more natural.

parameters.name: Cutoff
parameters.description: Cutoff frequency (the ladder's stages, the SVF's centre): where the resonance peaks and the filter self-oscillates
parameters.how: Sets the filter's frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz: the corner, or the centre for band-pass, notch and peak.
parameters.sound: Sweeping it makes the sound darker or brighter, or moves the thin band you hear.

parameters.name: Resonance
parameters.description: Resonance as the Q of the filter's resonant poles: 0.5 none, 0.71 flat (Butterworth), 2–5 a bump, 10 and up a whistle; at its top the filter self-oscillates, at a bounded level
parameters.how: Boosts the region around the cutoff by raising Q from 0.5 to 100.
parameters.sound: Low values sound plain, middle values add a bump, high values whistle and eventually ring on their own.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.description: Soft saturation before the filter, oversampled: quiet signals pass as they are, louder ones bend from −Drive dBFS; 0 dB is clean
parameters.how: Adds up to 24 dB of soft saturation before the filter.
parameters.sound: More drive thickens and warms the sound, and makes the resonance bite harder.

parameters.name: Env amount
parameters.description: How far the input's envelope moves the cutoff, in octaves at full envelope (negative: down)
parameters.how: Sets how far the input's loudness moves the cutoff, from -6 to +6 octaves.
parameters.sound: Positive values open the filter on loud notes for a wah or plucky sweep; negative values close it.

parameters.name: Env sensitivity
parameters.description: Gain on the detected level: the envelope is full when the input's peak reaches −Sensitivity dBFS
parameters.how: Sets how sensitive the envelope is, from -12 to +36 dB.
parameters.sound: Higher values make even quiet input sweep the filter fully; lower values need louder playing.

parameters.name: Env attack
parameters.description: Envelope follower attack: the time constant of its rise (63 % of a step)
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope rises when the input gets louder, from 0.1 ms to 0.5 s.
parameters.sound: Fast attacks snap the filter open on every hit; slow ones make a gradual swell.

parameters.name: Env release
parameters.description: Envelope follower release: the time constant of its fall (to 37 %)
parameters.how: Sets how fast the envelope falls when the input gets quieter, from 1 ms to 5 s.
parameters.sound: Short releases give a quick, bouncy wah; long ones let the filter glide slowly closed.

parameters.name: LFO rate
parameters.description: LFO speed when LFO sync is Free
parameters.how: Sets the LFO's speed, from 0.01 to 30 Hz, when LFO sync is Free.
parameters.sound: Slow rates make gentle sweeps over seconds, fast rates make wobbles and tremolo-like movement.

parameters.name: LFO sync
parameters.description: One LFO cycle per note value of the song's tempo (T triplet, D dotted); Free: LFO rate
parameters.how: Locks one LFO cycle to a note value of the song's tempo, from 1/32 to 16 bars, or leaves it Free.
parameters.sound: The movement stays in time with the music, so sweeps land on the beat.

parameters.name: LFO shape
parameters.description: LFO waveform (S&H: a random step per cycle; Smooth random: random points joined smoothly)
parameters.how: Chooses the LFO's waveform: sine, triangle, saw up, saw down, square, stepped random or smooth random.
parameters.sound: Sine and triangle sweep smoothly, saws ramp, square flips between two tones, random shapes wander.

parameters.name: LFO depth
parameters.description: How far the LFO moves the cutoff either way, in octaves
parameters.how: Sets how far the LFO moves the cutoff either way, from 0 to 4 octaves.
parameters.sound: Small depths add subtle movement; large ones sweep the whole sound open and shut.

parameters.name: LFO spread
parameters.description: The right channel's LFO phase against the left's: 0° both alike, 90° in quadrature, 180° opposite
parameters.how: Offsets the right channel's LFO phase from the left's, from 0 to 180 degrees.
parameters.sound: At 0 degrees both sides move together; wider offsets make the sweep travel across the stereo field.

parameters.name: LFO retrig
parameters.description: Free: the LFO runs on; Song: its phase follows the song's position while it plays (the same sweep on every pass and render); Env: it restarts at LFO phase when the input's envelope rises past half
parameters.how: Chooses when the LFO restarts: Free runs on, Song follows the song position, Env restarts on each rising input.
parameters.sound: Song repeats the same sweep on every pass; Env restarts the sweep on every hit.

parameters.name: LFO phase
parameters.description: The LFO's phase at the song's start (Song) or where it restarts (Env)
parameters.how: Sets the LFO's starting phase, from 0 to 360 degrees, at the start of the song or at each restart.
parameters.sound: It decides where in the sweep each pass begins, for example starting dark or starting bright.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry against filtered (a crossfade): 100 % only the filter
parameters.how: Blends the dry signal with the filtered signal.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep the original sound and add the filter as an accent; 100 % is only the filter.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Output gain, −24 … +24 dB in 0.1 dB steps
parameters.how: Adds -24 to +24 dB of gain after the filter.
parameters.sound: It restores the level lost to filtering, or keeps resonant peaks in check.
